blind_zone: an alert with lead in (240, 270] min before the breach and no alert in the window

cooldown_reasons.alert in window matched another event: an alert falls inside but the matching rule gave it to another event
cooldown_reasons.signal ended before the cooldown expired: the cooldown ends inside the window part but no candidate follows
cooldown_reasons.window hidden by an earlier alert: the last alert before the first inside candidate keeps the cooldown running past the end of the window part

events: notebook-2 4% catalog, dev events with breach in [2023-01-01 + 4h, 2026-05-01)
holdout: notebook-11 stored alerts only: blind-zone count (post hoc, descriptive); no score is recomputed on the holdout
policy_note: all replays use the notebook-16 frozen thresholds, start on 2023-01-01 and are descriptive; nothing is re-calibrated or selected

stages.0 ineligible: pre target only: no minute of the window is before the onset
stages.1 no signal: no candidate minute (score >= frozen threshold) from 240 min before the peak to the breach (pre: to the onset)
stages.2 outside window: candidates exist but none inside the window (pre: inside the pre-onset part of the window)
stages.3 cooldown: candidates inside, but the cooldown-only replay (no caps, 240-min cooldown) does not catch the event
stages.4 budget: the cooldown-only replay catches it but the actual budgeted replay does not
stages.caught: the actual budgeted replay catches it

targets.any: an alert 30-240 min before the breach (paper rule)
targets.pre: the matched alert is also before the 1% onset

title: Where missed crashes were lost: signal, window, cooldown, budget (dev 2023-01..2026-04, descriptive)
